request: Read-only DebugAI owning Host parent and nested worktree preflight against Current #41 / PR #115, no AI or runtime mutation

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
printf 'SC_HOST_HEAD='; git -C /home/admin1/server-core rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_REALPATH='; realpath "$p"
printf 'DEBUGAI_HEAD='; git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_BRANCH='; git -C "$p" branch --show-current
printf 'DEBUGAI_DIRTY='; if test -z "$(git -C "$p" status --porcelain)"; then echo NO; else echo YES; fi
printf 'DEBUGAI_WORKTREES='; git -C "$p" worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree / {print $2}'
